business.name: TPCDS 248 仓库地理分布
business.description: 按国家和省州统计仓库及覆盖城市数量，返回每组实际仓库主键范围；全仓库维表，无参数。

operation.statement:
SELECT
    w_country,                                              
    w_state,                                                
    COUNT(*)                AS warehouse_count,             
    COUNT(DISTINCT w_city)  AS city_count,                  
    MIN(w_warehouse_sk)     AS min_warehouse_sk,            
    MAX(w_warehouse_sk)     AS max_warehouse_sk             
FROM warehouse
GROUP BY
    w_country,
    w_state
ORDER BY
    w_country,
    w_state
